title: ZenithGateway / Operations

panels.title: Monitoring data · per instance
panels.description: 1: scrape succeeds and decision family exists (including registered zero counters). 0: scrape fails. 2: scrape succeeds but decisions are missing; check observability.enabled/version/relabel. No data: target is not discovered. Presence is not a health verdict.

targets.expr: (count by (job, instance) (zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"}) > bool 0 and on (job, instance) (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1)) or on (job, instance) (2 * ((up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) unless on (job, instance) count by (job, instance) (zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"}))) or on (job, instance) (0 * (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 0))

panels.title: Ready
panels.description: Current readiness per selected instance, only with a successful scrape. Readiness is not a statement about limiter failure policy or all instances.

panels.title: Final requests / s
panels.description: One terminal request record per gateway entry, including errors and cancellations. Limiter forward decisions do not prove HTTP success or upstream receipt.

options.content:
**Instance** selects the same target across every panel. Rates use the last **1 minute**. **Unknown debit overlaps actions — never add it to the request total.**

A protective rejection selects **503**; quota rejection selects **429**. Forward is permission to proceed, not proof of upstream receipt. No ratio is shown at zero traffic. Check **Monitoring data** before interpreting an empty panel.

panels.title: Quota permitted
panels.description: Redis confirmed the quota decision; later proxying can still fail. Per-instance decisions/s over 1m. Registered counters show 0 when idle; missing/failed scrape shows no data.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance",event="allowed",action="forward"}[1m])) and on (instance) (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on (instance) count by (instance) (zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Explicit bypass
panels.description: The runtime limiter is explicitly disabled. This is not Redis fault admission. Per-instance decisions/s over 1m. Registered counters show 0 when idle; missing/failed scrape shows no data.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance",event="disabled",action="forward"}[1m])) and on (instance) (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on (instance) count by (instance) (zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Quota / 429
panels.description: Confirmed quota refusal, including cost exceeding capacity. Final HTTP may be cancelled before delivery. Per-instance decisions/s over 1m. Registered counters show 0 when idle; missing/failed scrape shows no data.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance",event=~"limited|unfulfillable",action="reject"}[1m])) and on (instance) (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on (instance) count by (instance) (zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Fault forward
panels.description: Failure policy chose forwarding without quota confirmation. Break down local versus Redis in the decisions chart. Per-instance decisions/s over 1m. Registered counters show 0 when idle; missing/failed scrape shows no data.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance",event=~"local_unavailable|redis_unconfirmed",action="forward"}[1m])) and on (instance) (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on (instance) count by (instance) (zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Protective / 503
panels.description: Failure policy chose rejection before proxying. Separate from normal quota exhaustion. Per-instance decisions/s over 1m. Registered counters show 0 when idle; missing/failed scrape shows no data.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance",event=~"local_unavailable|redis_unconfirmed",action="reject"}[1m])) and on (instance) (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on (instance) count by (instance) (zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Debit unknown *
panels.description: Includes forward, reject and cancel. Redis may have consumed tokens. This dimension overlaps the other cards; it is not an additional request class. Per-instance decisions/s over 1m. Registered counters show 0 when idle; missing/failed scrape shows no data.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance",execution="unknown"}[1m])) and on (instance) (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on (instance) count by (instance) (zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Limiter decisions · fact + action
panels.description: Non-overlapping fact/action classes including cancellations. Rate per second over 1m. Compare with terminal HTTP outcomes separately; unknown debit is a separate overlapping dimension.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance",event="allowed",action="forward"}[1m])) and on (instance) (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on (instance) count by (instance) (zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"})

sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance",event="disabled",action="forward"}[1m])) and on (instance) (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on (instance) count by (instance) (zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"})

sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance",event=~"limited|unfulfillable",action="reject"}[1m])) and on (instance) (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on (instance) count by (instance) (zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"})

sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance",event="local_unavailable",action="forward"}[1m])) and on (instance) (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on (instance) count by (instance) (zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"})

sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance",event="redis_unconfirmed",action="forward"}[1m])) and on (instance) (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on (instance) count by (instance) (zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"})

sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance",event="local_unavailable",action="reject"}[1m])) and on (instance) (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on (instance) count by (instance) (zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"})

sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance",event="redis_unconfirmed",action="reject"}[1m])) and on (instance) (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on (instance) count by (instance) (zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"})

sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance",event="cancelled",action="cancel"}[1m])) and on (instance) (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on (instance) count by (instance) (zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Debit unknown · action breakdown
panels.description: Unknown debit includes dispatch followed by cancellation. All actions remain counted here. The uncertainty alert uses only forward/reject (estimated increase >= 3 per 1m for 30s), reducing cancellation noise.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, action) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance",execution="unknown"}[1m])) and on (instance) (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on (instance) count by (instance) (zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Fault-action share · all limiter decisions
panels.description: Denominator: all terminal limiter decisions for this instance, including explicit bypass and cancellation. Numerators are disjoint fault actions. Unknown is not added. Zero denominator intentionally produces no ratio, not an error and not a fabricated 0%. Failed/missing scrape produces no data.

targets.expr: ((100 * sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance",event=~"local_unavailable|redis_unconfirmed",action="forward"}[1m])) / sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"}[1m]))) and on (instance) (sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"}[1m])) > 0)) and on (instance) (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on (instance) count by (instance) (zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"})

((100 * sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance",event=~"local_unavailable|redis_unconfirmed",action="reject"}[1m])) / sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"}[1m]))) and on (instance) (sum by (instance) (rate(zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"}[1m])) > 0)) and on (instance) (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on (instance) count by (instance) (zenith_ratelimit_decisions_total{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Limiter decision wait · P95 / P99
panels.description: Wall-clock time from filter decision subscription until decision delivery or cancellation: local queue, connection, Redis round trip/timeout, decoding and optional result handoff plus scheduling pauses. Excludes subsequent upstream handling; disabled bypass is not timed. NOT Redis Lua execution time. Legacy timer outcome=error covers both fail-open and protective rejection.

panels.title: Final requests · HTTP class + outcome
panels.description: Terminal request statistics, including cancelled and error results. A recorded status is not proof the client received it. Upstream receipt requires independent upstream/audit evidence; this dashboard does not invent a delivery metric.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, status, outcome) (rate(zenith_gateway_requests_seconds_count{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"}[1m])) and on (instance) (up{job="zenith-gateway",instance=~"$instance"} == 1)

panels.description: Aggregatable histogram estimates.

panels.description: Redis confirmation does not imply disk durability.

description: Limiter facts, chosen actions and final request outcomes are separate. Unknown debit overlaps action counts. Use Instance to localize; data availability distinguishes idle traffic from failed or missing scrapes.
